game_title: Call Stack Tower – Ice Mill Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Ice Mill, a frozen mill wheel: the frost mage must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Mill: a frozen mill wheel
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Mill, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about stack_height to power up the frost mage and open the wall banner.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 4 (applied tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
